meta.title: Alexis Sanchis - Fullstack software engineer, web and mobile
meta.description: Fullstack software engineer, web and mobile (React, Next.js, React Native, Android). From 2018 to 2025, healthcare and home-care software, built in teams.

hero.role: Fullstack software engineer, web and mobile
hero.bio: I've been building web and mobile apps since 2017. From 2018 to 2025, I mostly worked on healthcare and home-care software. I now work at Elipce Solutions.

items.name: React, Next.js
items.text: Since 2023, in teams at CBA and then Elipce, and on my own projects.

items.name: React Native, Ionic/Capacitor
items.text: Cross-platform mobile apps, with Ionic/Capacitor at Elipce since 2025.

items.name: Android
items.text: From 2018 to 2023 at Arche MC2, on offline-first apps.

items.name: Claude Code
items.text: I build with agents, and I review everything that goes to production. Still learning to make good use of [pstack](https://github.com/cursor/plugins/tree/main/pstack), Lauren Tan's skills for agents.

items.title: Opaline Santé
items.text: Fullstack development, in a team, on the home-care booking platform (80,000+ users), and contributions to its UI component library.

items.title: Offline-first apps for home care
items.text: Team development of Android apps for home-care services, nursing homes and meal delivery: a SQLite database on the device, synced in the background when the network comes back.

items.title: Subscription platform for a speech therapist
items.text: Design and development of the whole platform: online exercises offered as a monthly subscription.

items.title: Joinery application
items.text: Team development of the joinery engine and of the performance calculation for each product, such as Uw (thermal transmittance) and TL (light transmittance).

items.title: Augmented reality app
items.text: Cross-platform app showing geolocated points of interest in real time, with a native layer for iPad.

experience.title: Experience

items.summary: Custom web and mobile apps for various clients, front end to back end.
Software for independent healthcare professionals, including Opaline Santé.
Development of an augmented reality app.

education: M.Sc. in Software Engineering, University of Avignon (CERI), 2015–2017
